title: Every Fight Is Followed By A Century

runtime.timing: requestAnimationFrame with variable delta capped at 50ms; window.advanceTime exposes fixed 60Hz stepping for observation
runtime.input: Unified logical action state in src/input.ts with held, pressed, released actions sourced from keyboard, mouse, touch (movement joystick, look zone, contextual action cluster), and gamepad (standard-layout stick/button mapping), pointer-lock look, and deterministic frame consumption
runtime.camera: Third-person chase camera with yaw/pitch clamp, speed FOV, pointer lock, touch-drag look, obstruction pull-in, shake reduction, and sensitivity settings
runtime.physics: application-owned kinematic traversal plus bounded rubble velocities; no general-purpose rigid-body solver
runtime.combat: bounded player strike/shockwave, pursuing rival, and player vitality; no environmental enemy destruction
runtime.destruction: stateful building/bridge/landmark integrity and support propagation, visible rubble, and terrain scars; no general-purpose structural solver
runtime.persistence: version-3 localStorage campaign envelope (city fabric + landmark structure added in v3) with versionless-save rewrite and malformed/future-save recovery, plus an independently versioned settings envelope in src/settings.ts; no IndexedDB
runtime.instancing: InstancedMesh for traffic (three distinct sedan/van/bus meshes, not one repeated box), pedestrians, and street-level city detail
runtime.gamepad: standard-layout Gamepad API polling in src/input.ts (sticks for move/look, buttons for actions)
runtime.spatialPartitioning: src/spatialGrid.ts: uniform cell grid; buildings are inserted once at startup and every wall/grapple/shockwave proximity query in src/main.ts goes through it; render_game_to_text().activeChunkCount reports the real occupied-cell count
runtime.qualityGovernor: src/quality.ts: frame-budget AUTO/LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH with hysteresis; manual tier selection overrides automatic quality; touch input is not treated as a low-quality signal
runtime.cityFabric: src/city.ts: parcel land use, district identity, landmark lifecycle with stable ids, and public-memory markers derived from (but not overwriting) objective history events
runtime.publicMemoryVisuals: src/main.ts: every projectPublicMemory() call (collapse, landmark damage, archaeology-recovery corrective marker) spawns an inspectable plaque mesh at the site; a rebuilt parcel that carries forward relic material gets a distinct lineage marker; both mesh sets are bounded with oldest-first disposal, independent of the unbounded save data
runtime.reconstructionSequence: src/main.ts updateReconstructions(): a century-advance rebuild grows a parcel's mesh from near-zero height over ~3s and eases its color toward its new land-use tint instead of snapping instantly
runtime.resourceLifecycle: rubble and terrain-scar meshes are capped (140 / 60) with oldest-first scene.remove()+geometry/material.dispose() so long sessions cannot leak GPU resources; objective history and save state are never trimmed
runtime.tests: 48 Vitest checks (16 foundation + 32 expansion, including spatial-grid unit tests), direct Playwright traversal/destruction/combat/save-migration journey, and a request-animation-frame Phase 1 performance baseline

truthBoundary: The active entry completes the bounded Phase 1 traversal gate and adds unified input/settings/quality/city-fabric systems, but is not the canonical 100,000-year campaign world and does not itself complete Canonical Phase 2 (structural combat/destruction expansion). Its compact history and deep-time helpers, and all later phase systems, remain provisional until their completion contracts are proven.
